report_paragraph: The same calibrated massless gates also pass a transverse Maxwell-wave check on the supplied 3+1 plane metric. The combinations sqrt(N)(E_y +/- B_z) obey the earlier transport operator. Two counterpropagating real waves show about fourfold field-error reduction per grid doubling; at 2,048 sites the relative field error is 7.06e-05. The conserved Killing energy is preserved to 3e-16. This covers this one-dimensional plane-wave sector, not general 3D electromagnetism or quantized photons.
